column1: # check-skill.tsv -- how scripts/check-skill.sh orders and selects this
# skill's suites. scripts/check-skill.sh's header defines both kinds of row;
# .claude/shirabe-extensions/README.md has the rule for keeping them current.
# shared <file under scripts/>: a change to it runs every suite. A file
# sourced by two or more of the skill's files is shared without a row; these
# are the ones that check can't see: the template's own scripts, which every
# engine suite drives; the state schema, which jq includes and nearly every
# script reads or writes through; and run-tests.sh, which CI runs every suite
# cost <suite> <seconds>: the suite's CPU seconds (user plus system), measured
# on main at 05d3a50 with four suites at a time on a loaded host. Suites
# launch costliest first; a suite with no row launches after the rest. The
# rows of the suites #830 cut are scaled by each suite's measured after/before
# ratio, so they stay on the same scale as the rest.
